sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS We may issue and sell, from time to time, shares of our common stock having aggregate gross sales proceeds of up to $600 million. The amount of proceeds from this offering will depend upon the number of shares of our common stock sold and the market price at which they are sold, subject to a maximum of $600 million. There can be no assurance that we will sell any shares under or fully utilize the Equity Distribution Agreement with our sales agents and the forward purchasers, as applicable, as a source of financing. We intend to use the net proceeds from the sale of our common stock from time to time and any net proceeds we receive pursuant to any settlement of any forward sale agreement with the relevant forward purchaser to fund future potential acquisitions and for general corporate purposes.
